Jess L: Heads-up — proposed SDK change that will start surfacing routing + quota headers by default in next minor (1.2.0). We need a rollout plan for devex + eng-platform + Go/TS/Py owners.
Maya R: Is this the x-redwood-route/x-redwood-cost-center headers we discussed?
Jess L: yup. example: `x-redwood-route: project=alpha;priority=low` and `x-redwood-cost-center: cc-12345`
Dmitri K: Concern: some internal proxies strip unknown headers. If we flip to default-on, certain customers behind our proxy could lose routing context.
Samir G: Go SDK uses a custom RoundTripper for instrumentation. It currently normalizes headers; could drop structured semicolon values. I can add safe encoding but that is a breaking behaviour for anyone parsing raw header strings.
Maya R: Suggestion: introduce an opt-in env var/SDK flag first (e.g., `enable_route_hints=true`) and a telemetry opt-in for console attribution. Then after 6 weeks, flip default after QA.
Anika P: Console needs consistent cost-center attr for dashboards. If header format changes during rollout we'll get split metrics (cc-123 vs cc%3A123). We should define canonical encoding and include sample payloads in docs.
Jess L: Agreed on canonicalization. Proposal: header format = urlsafe base64 of JSON for complex metadata, but keep simple k=v; pairs for humans. Example: `x-redwood-route: b64.eyJwcm9qIjoiYXBpIn0=` or `project=alpha;priority=low`
Dmitri K: B64 JSON is safer but larger. Some customers hit header-size limits ~8KB with large context. We should fail gracefully and fall back to route-id only.
Samir G: I'll add fallback: if encoded_len > 1024 => send `x-redwood-route-id: r-<hash>` and emit debug log. Will need SDK churn across languages.
platform-bot: CI: go-sdk-integration-tests #build-9812 succeeded :white_check_mark:
Maya R: For rollout UX: devex will add an announcement + migration checklist. Also create an opt-in beta channel for early adopters.
Jess L: Plan draft: 1) Feature flag opt-in release to npm/pypi/golang (minor) 2) 2-week beta (telemetry sampling) 3) Docs + migration guide + console mapping 4) Default-on flip after opt-in feedback 5) Post-rollout monitor & rollback playbook.
Anika P: Can we add a console toggle to map legacy header values -> canonical? That would reduce metric churn.
Dmitri K: We'll need a small mapping service or a regex transform in telemetry pipeline. I'll scope impact.
Samir G: Timeline: I can land Go fallback & tests by EOD Fri, but need coordination for TS + Py owners.
Jess L: Thanks — @Dmitri K please create ENG-TRACK ticket with migration steps, @Maya R pls draft announcement. I'll post SDK flags and example snippets in the thread.
Maya R: Draft announcement ready, will share tomorrow. :sparkles:
Jess L: OK team — main actions: ticket, opt-in flags, encoding spec, console mapping. Keeping this thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
